Root Cause Analysis — 6 issues
Reviews → Negative Handling 2.0
Zero negative or moderate reviews displayed. No evidence of brand responses to concerns. For a 5-6 month treatment protocol with '93% success' claim, the absence of any reviews addressing the 7% who didn't see results is conspicuous.
Surface 2-3 authentic 2-3 star reviews that mention slow results or technique issues. Add visible brand responses demonstrating: (1) personalized troubleshooting offered, (2) dermaroller technique correction, (3) timeline expectation management. Position these as 'See how we support every journey' — proving the brand stands behind partial responders.
Reviews → Freshness 3.0
All 4 reviews are clustered in a narrow 6-day window (March 10-16, 2026), approximately 168-174 days old. No reviews from the last 5 months.
Deploy a 3-stage post-purchase email sequence: Day 30 ('How's the shedding phase going?'), Day 90 ('Seeing stabilization?'), Day 150 ('Share your transformation'). Incentivize 90-day+ reviews specifically. Add a 'Long-term Results' review filter to showcase sustained efficacy — the exact proof this persona needs.
Persona × Narrative → Hero / Banner 4.5
The headline 'Advanced Hair Regrowth Regime' is generic and fails to address The Treatment Optimizer's #1 concern: that months of consistent treatment may have been partially wasted due to suboptimal delivery.
Replace headline with: 'Your Minoxidil Worked. Your Scalp Couldn't Absorb It.' or 'Still Applying Daily? Here's What Your Minoxidil Has Been Missing.' Immediately follow with: 'The dermaroller creates 600% better absorption — turning your existing routine into actual results.' This validates past effort while positioning the product as the missing multiplier, not a replacement.
Persona × Narrative → CTA Language 4.0
'Add to Cart' and 'Buy Now' are transactional and generic. These CTAs don't reflect the emotional state of validated frustration resolved by a concrete upgrade.
Replace primary CTA with: 'Complete Your Protocol' (acknowledges existing routine). Secondary CTA: 'Add the Missing 600%' (references absorption benefit). Mobile sticky CTA: 'Fix Your Current Routine → ₹X/month'. This language pattern confirms: 'We know you've been trying. This closes the gap.'
Ad Alignment → ATC Drop-off Addressed 4.5
'Initial shedding' warning upfront may scare users without adequate reassurance. '5-6 months for results' feels long without intermediate wins. 'Some users report mild facial hair growth' is a negative planted late in the copy. No price anchoring against alternatives.
Restructure the timeline section as 'Your 4 Progress Checkpoints': Week 2-4: 'Shedding = it's working. Weak hairs clearing for stronger growth.' Month 2: 'Scalp texture change — you'll feel it.' Month 3-4: 'First visible baby hairs.' Month 5-6: 'Density you can photograph.' Add price anchor: '₹X/month vs. ₹15,000+ for one PRP session.' Insert 90-day money-back guarantee badge directly above CTA.
Visual Design → Lifestyle Shots 4.5
Image 33 shows stressed man at laptop illustrating the stress/lifestyle problem but not the aspirational outcome. No images showing the persona's desired life: confident professional in meetings, social gatherings, dating scenarios.
Add 3 lifestyle shots: (1) Confident man presenting in a modern office — hair visible, not the focus, (2) Social scene — group dinner or rooftop drinks, subject relaxed and engaged, (3) Active moment — running, gym, or outdoor activity with natural hair movement. Position these in the middle scroll, after efficacy claims, as visual proof of the emotional payoff.

Rewrite to: 'Your Minoxidil Wasn't Wrong. The Delivery Was.' or 'Still on Minoxidil? Here's What's Been Missing for 12 Months.' — directly addressing the Treatment Optimizer's suspicion that 'either the product isn't working or I'm missing something.'
Carousel Flow
5.0/10
Carousel slides are labeled generically (live_1 through live_5) without visible content details, but the body copy suggests the flow moves: benefits → plan contents → causes → timeline → credentials. This misses the narrative arc required: it doesn't open with a hook that validates existing effort ('Your consistency wasn't wasted'), nor does it explicitly frame the problem as an absorption gap before introducing CETOSOMAL as the solution. Banner Alignment

Body Copy (14 blocks)
Advanced Regime for Better Results
Combines topical, nutritional and mechanical support for visible regrowth over 5–6 months.
FDA-approved
No Side Effects
10L+ Saw Results
Backed by Experts
No Irritation or Dryness
The patented CETOSOMAL® technology helps in 3x deeper penetration for improved effectiveness.
Alcohol-free, moisturising and hydrating formulation designed for daily use on Indian scalps.
Three major differences: (1) Our formula adds topical Finasteride to block DHT — Minoxidil alone only stimulates growth without addressing the root cause. (2) CETOSOMAL® technology delivers 2–3x better penetration than standard aqueous formulas. (3) Our formula is alcohol-free, preventing the scalp dryness common with other products, especially important in Indian conditions.
+ 4 more blocks
Our topical Finasteride formulation is specifically designed for localized delivery, resulting in significantly lower systemic absorption compared to oral Finasteride pills. Studies show topical application achieves comparable DHT reduction at the scalp with a fraction of the systemic exposure.
Initial shedding (usually in weeks 2–6) is actually a positive sign that the treatment is working. Minoxidil pushes follicles from the resting phase into the growth phase. The old, weak, miniaturized hairs fall out to make room for new, stronger hair growth. This is temporary and subsides within 4–8 weeks.
Hair growth takes time, expect 5–6 months of consistent use to see visible results. Month 1–2: Shedding phase Month 3–4: Stabilization and early regrowth Month 5–6: Visible improvement 92.7% of users see results by month 5–6.
With topical application, hair growth is localized to where you apply it. Some users report mild facial hair growth if solution runs down from the scalp - wipe the area after application to avoid run-off.

Expert-led hair regrowth for Indian men
FDA-approved
10L+ Saw Results
Backed by Experts
No Irritation or Dryness
Combines topical, nutritional and mechanical support for visible regrowth over 5–6 months.
The patented CETOSOMAL® technology helps in 2x deeper penetration for improved effectiveness.
Alcohol-free, moisturising and hydrating formulation designed for daily use on Indian scalps.
Three major differences: (1) Our formula adds topical Finasteride to block DHT — Minoxidil alone only stimulates growth without addressing the root cause. (2) CETOSOMAL® technology delivers 2–3x better penetration than standard aqueous formulas. (3) Our formula is alcohol-free, preventing the scalp dryness common with other products, especially important in Indian conditions.
Our topical Finasteride formulation is specifically designed for localized delivery, resulting in significantly lower systemic absorption compared to oral Finasteride pills. Studies show topical application achieves comparable DHT reduction at the scalp with a fraction of the systemic exposure.
+ 6 more blocks
Initial shedding (usually in weeks 2–6) is actually a positive sign that the treatment is working. Here's why: Minoxidil pushes follicles from the resting phase into the growth phase. The old, weak, miniaturized hairs fall out to make room for new, stronger hair growth. This is temporary and subsides within 4–8 weeks. Don't stop treatment during this phase, that's when it matters most.
Hair growth takes time, expect 5–6 months of consistent use to see visible results. Month 1–2: Shedding phase Month 3–4: Stabilization and early regrowth Month 5–6: Visible improvement 92.7% of users see results by month 5–6. The Advanced Protocol may show results 4–6 weeks faster than our Essential formula.
With topical application, hair growth is localized to where you apply it. Some users report mild facial hair growth if solution runs down from the scalp - wipe the area after application to avoid run-off.
Talking about personal health is hard. Often embarrassing. We get that. So we took 'matters' into our own hands; and created a place for all matters of man. Hair, skin, weight, sleep, performance and much more. We get you, and we get what matters to you.
With so many unreliable sources and searches, it's hard to decide whom to trust. Our solutions are trusted by experts, and are backed by science. We believe that wellness has a science behind it and we want to make it more accessible.
Wellness is an actively pursued goal of being in a state of good health. We believe that compliance and discipline matter if you want to move towards wellbeing, and we get that it's not easy. We are here to handhold you and help you on this journey.
